primary_sequence_neighbor.alignment: Biopython PairwiseAligner global; match=2 mismatch=-1 gap_open=-3 gap_extend=-0.5; first optimal alignment
primary_sequence_neighbor.identity_definition: identical aligned residue pairs / max(sequence lengths), including gaps implicitly in denominator; not CD-HIT identity

primary_physicochemical.meaning: low-Cys cationic hydrophobic short-peptide candidate, not confirmed membrane toxicity

annotation_screen.meaning: function mentions only; may contain negatives, similarity inference or whole-molecule claims, not direct endpoint validation

rates: FN/(TP+FN) for original positives and FP/(FP+TN) for original negatives; label/fold stratified; group bootstrap CI

feature_comparison.controls: original positive fusion TP from same cohort
feature_comparison.match: same fold, different group, length difference <=3, KR-DE charge difference <=2, mean hydropathy difference <=0.5, Cys difference <=1; greedy smallest eligible pool then normalized distance then sample_id; no group reused
feature_comparison.inference: paired mean difference FN minus TP; paired bootstrap CI and 5000 random sign flips; BH over 12 tests (6 features x 2 partitions); null/low counts retained

restrictions: sequence proximity and descriptor matching are not experimental mechanism evidence
anchor discovery and historical OOF selection biases persist
